title: Zesty Nutty Portuguese Rhubarb Tagine
description: A kid-friendly Portuguese dish featuring rhubarb, with a nutty and glassy-jelly texture, made in a tagine pot and Whole30-friendly. The shio-koji cure adds a unique flavor to the rhubarb.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced almonds, shio-koji cure, and grated ginger.
Add the fresh rhubarb to the bowl and toss to coat with the almond mixture.
In a small bowl, whisk together the raw honey, lemon juice, and sea salt.
Pour the honey mixture over the rhubarb mixture and toss to coat.
Transfer the mixture to a tagine pot and add the filtered water.
Cover the tagine pot and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the tagine pot from the oven and let it cool to room temperature.
Serve the Zesty Nutty Portuguese Rhubarb Tagine chilled, garnished with additional sliced almonds if desired.
